claims: The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is launching March 31, 2026.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is part of the McDonald's "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features a Spicy Saja McMuffin.
The Spicy Saja McMuffin is a Sausage McMuffin with Egg and peppery sauce.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features hash browns.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal features a small soft drink ("Soda Pop").
The sandwich in the Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is a Sausage McMuffin with Egg featuring a new Spicy Saja Sauce.
The sides in the Saja Boys Breakfast Meal are Hash Browns.
The drink in the Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is a small soft drink.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes a set of 2 photocards from a collection of 8.
The photocards feature Jinu and the Saja Boys.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes a Derpy access card.
The Derpy access card unlocks content on the McDonald's App by April 26.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal has approximately 800 calories.
The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is part of a "battle" against the HUNTR/X meal.
The "battle" encourages fans to choose sides based on the Netflix film collaboration.
The promotion is available for a limited time in the US.
